params.prompt:
A hiker arrives at a lakeside clearing at dusk with the TrailMaster X4, a four-person dome tent with a forest-green body under a burnt-orange rainfly, pitches it in seconds,
and by night it glows warm from inside while rain falls. Audio: footsteps, pole clicks, rain on fabric.

multi_prompt.prompt: Wide shot: a hiker reaches a lakeside clearing at dusk carrying the TrailMaster X4, a four-person dome tent with a forest-green body under a burnt-orange rainfly in its bag. Audio: footsteps on gravel.
Close-up: hands snap the aluminum poles together and the tent rises in seconds. Audio: pole clicks, fabric rustle.
Wide shot: night, rain falls, the tent glows warm from inside on the shore. Audio: rain on fabric, soft wind.
